messages.subject: Two-way interaction in SEM: latent variable with continuous x latent variable and binary indicators
parts:
Dear All,

Does anyone know a strategy to model interaction between a latent variable with continuous indicators and a another one with binary indicators?

I've tried indProd{semTools}, but it only works with numeric class.

I will be glad with any tip.

Thanks in advance.

Best regards,
